en: It makes me sad that the café is closing down.
es: Me da pena que el café cierre.
why: Sadness over a loss is pena.

en: It makes me angry that they lie to Rosa.
es: Me da rabia que le mientan a Rosa.
why: Anger at something unfair is rabia.

en: It makes me angry that nobody says thank you.
es: Me da rabia que nadie dé las gracias.

en: It makes me sad that Don Hernando is alone.
es: Me da pena que Don Hernando esté solo.

en: I'm sad that you can't come. (to a friend)
es: Me da pena que no puedas venir.

en: It makes me angry that they raise the rent every year.
es: Me da rabia que suban el arriendo cada año.
why: Anger at something unfair is rabia.

en: It makes me sad that the kids are leaving the neighborhood.
es: Me da pena que los niños se vayan del barrio.
why: Sadness at a loss is pena.

en: It makes me angry that they park on the sidewalk.
es: Me da rabia que parqueen en el andén.
why: Anger at rude behavior is rabia.
